title: Kiritani Haruka — Pouring My Heart In〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for agreeing to gather here today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's fine, but why did you ask to see us all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I wanted to thank all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how you all made those wraps for me while I was practicing for the commercial?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They were just what I needed to keep going when I was starting to feel the fatigue.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With every bite I took, your kindness allowed me to continue persevering.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Then, I'm glad we were able to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, coming up with them was definitely worth it now!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Wait, is it really okay for me to be here?
Compared to them, I hardly did a thing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because you're always providing me with so much support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I took this opportunity to show my appreciation for you?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
A-Absolutely...!!
I'm ready to take whatever it is you're going to throw at me...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wonderful...!
Thank you, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what do you have in store for us exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted to thank you all for making those wraps for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Though, I can't do anything too fancy, so I'm just going to make rice balls for all of you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, but I do have quite a lot of ingredients on hand, so I plan to make some omelets too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Shizuku. That should be plenty.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't wait to try your rice balls, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! I promise to make them with plenty of love, so if you'll give me just a moment...
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you think she's gonna be okay on her own?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's made rice balls before, so she should be fine, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
T-True...
She's trying her best right now, so I guess we should believe in her and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku?! What happened just now?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That was really loud...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, umm... The sound the rice cooker made when I pressed the button was just so startling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
But everything's okay!
I think I just pushed the button before it was ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
Then, I guess we have nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sorry for causing you all so much concern. Please feel free to relax in the living room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is she really going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I just hope she's using the right amount of water. Also, does she know about its fast-cook feature...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's going to take about an hour if she lets it cook normally, which I don't really mind, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, let's keep believing in her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But...
I feel like we should be able to respond at a moment's notice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
Let's see... The sugar for the eggs should be..
Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm still worried...
What if she dumps in all of it by accident?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-There's no need to fear!
I'm sure she won't let her hand slip or anything...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And if she does end up dumping in all the sugar, I'll happily eat whatever she ends up making...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please don't, for your own sake...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: H-Hot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is she okay? Did she just burn herself...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: It's only natural for freshly cooked rice to be this hot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: But I need to make these rice balls before it cools, since they'll taste better that way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can do it, Shizuku...!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for your patience...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I apologize for taking up so much of your time. I regret not cooking the rice further in advance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After all, they say that hunger is the best seasoning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, please have these while they're still hot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! These look so yummy...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, and they smell delicious! My appetite's growing bigger by the second!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The rice even has a nice sheen to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. It looks like she used the right amount of water.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, without further ado, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Saito
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... How are they?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! The rice is so fluffy, and you used just the right amount of salt! I could have these forever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The omelets are also really fluffy!
There's just the right amount of juiciness, so they go perfectly with the rice balls!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes... They're both amazing...!
It's clear that you made these with great care... These rice balls will help me keep working by getting back up to full power!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad we kept believing in her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. But these rice balls really are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for making these for us, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
You're very welcome!
